4. How the application works

The application reads the game's network traffic on your computer (through the Npcap driver, installed separately under its own license) to calculate damage, healing and other combat statistics. It does not modify the game client, inject code into the game, send input to the game or automate actions. The data it reads stays on your computer, unless you choose to upload a fight.

6. Accounts and uploaded content

  • Sign-in uses Discord: we only receive your Discord account ID, display name and avatar.
  • When you upload a fight you choose its visibility: public, unlisted or private. Public and unlisted logs can be seen by anyone with the link; public logs contribute, in aggregate form and without names, to the per-class statistics.
  • You can change the visibility of your logs or delete them at any time from the application.
  • You agree not to upload forged or tampered content, not to try to access other users' data and not to overload or attack our servers. We may remove content and suspend accounts that breach these terms.

7. Permitted use

The Service is for personal, non-commercial use. The free version is offered free of charge; the paid features and their conditions are described in section 8. You may not resell the Service or access to it, distribute modified versions presented as official, or use it for unlawful purposes.

8. Free version, trial and subscriptions

Free version

The meter (live damage, healing and aggro) and all the features not listed under the plans below are free and stay free: they require neither a trial nor a subscription. Signing in with Discord is only needed for the online features, the trial and the subscriptions.

14-day free trial

  • The trial unlocks, free of charge and for 14 days, everything included in the Daeva plan.
  • It starts automatically the first time the app checks your plan after you sign in with Discord, and not before the subscriptions launch. Days are counted on our server's clock.
  • There is one trial per Discord account, and only for Discord accounts created at least 30 days earlier (the creation date is derived from the account ID). Reinstalling the app or changing computer does not renew it. Accounts that do not qualify can use the free version and subscribe normally.
  • When the trial ends the paid features lock again. The trial never turns into a paid subscription by itself: nothing is charged unless you subscribe on Patreon.

Plans

  • Recruit, 3 € per month: Database (items, skills, NPCs, quests, dungeons, Gear Viewer), fight reports, online logs and leaderboards; role and badge on Discord.
  • Daeva, 7 € per month: everything in Recruit, plus party and rotations, crafting helper and calculator; live chat on Discord.
  • Empyrean, 15 € per month: everything in Daeva, plus custom features on request; a private Discord channel and direct support from the developers.

Prices are those shown on Patreon, which may add VAT or other taxes depending on your country; Patreon may also offer the same plans with annual billing. Discord benefits are assigned through Patreon's Discord integration and are available once the PowerMeter Discord server is open. We may change the content or price of the plans: significant changes will be announced in advance and a price change never applies to a period you have already paid.

Payment, renewal and cancellation

  • You subscribe on Patreon. Patreon handles payment, billing, automatic renewal (monthly, or annual if you choose it), cancellation, refunds and taxes under its own terms of use. We never receive your card or payment details.
  • You can cancel at any time from your Patreon account. After cancelling, the paid features remain available as long as Patreon reports your membership as entitled to the plan, usually until the end of the period already paid.
  • If Patreon cannot collect a payment, the paid features remain available for a grace period of 3 days; after that they lock until the payment goes through.
  • Refund requests and the right of withdrawal are handled by Patreon, under its terms and the applicable law. This does not limit the rights that the law grants you as a consumer.

Linking Patreon and offline use

  • To unlock your plan you link your Patreon account in the app (Supporter page). A Patreon account can be linked to only one PowerMeter account: linking it to another account unlinks it from the previous one.
  • Our server checks your plan with Patreon (through Patreon's notifications and periodic checks) and gives the app a digitally signed permit. The permit lets the app work offline for up to 7 days; after that the app must connect to confirm the plan. Changes to your plan, including its end, reach the app when it connects and in any case within 7 days.

When a subscription ends

When the subscription or the trial ends, the paid tabs lock again and show how to unlock them. The data saved on your computer (fights, characters, builds, settings) is not deleted. Content the app downloads from our servers for the paid features (for example the Database) may be unavailable until you subscribe again.

Plans granted by us, Empyrean features and Founder badge

  • We may grant a plan free of charge, for a limited or unlimited time (for example to testers, partners or as compensation), and revoke it. A granted plan is not a Patreon subscription: it does not renew and nothing is charged.
  • Empyrean custom features are developed on request and agreed with us case by case: feasibility, scope and timing are at our discretion, and they are available only while the Empyrean plan is active.
  • Members who start a paid subscription during a launch period announced by us receive a "Founder" badge in the app. The badge has no monetary value and does not unlock any feature.

Fair use

  • Plans are personal: do not share or resell your PowerMeter or Patreon account, the permit or access to the paid features.
  • Do not try to bypass the plan checks: do not create Discord accounts to obtain more trials, do not forge or reuse permits or requests to our servers, and do not use modified versions of the app to access paid online content without an active plan. The license of the app's source code is not affected: this rule concerns access to our online services.
  • If these rules are broken we may revoke the trial, suspend access to the paid features and suspend the account, telling you the reason where possible.

9. Intellectual property

The PowerMeter name, logo, the design of the website and the application and the original texts belong to Letrion Labs. The application's source code, where published, is governed by the license stated in its repository. Game maps are derived from the aion2-interactive-map project (CC BY-NC license).

10. No warranty

The Service is provided "as is" and "as available". Statistics are calculated from network traffic and may be incomplete or inaccurate, especially after game updates. We do not guarantee that the Service will always be available, error-free or compatible with every version of the game.

11. Limitation of liability

privacy:
Privacy policy

Last updated: 29 September 2026

1. Data controller

The data controller is Letrion Labs di Nazario De Letteriis, a sole proprietorship based at Viale Marina 119, 47030 San Mauro Pascoli (FC), Italy, VAT no. IT04862390400, tax code DLTNRN80C02I158W. For any question about your data write to info@letrionlabs.it.

2. In short

  • The website uses no cookies, analytics, pixels or tracking tools, and loads no fonts or scripts from external services.
  • The desktop app processes combat data on your computer. Combat data only reaches our servers if you sign in with Discord and choose to upload a fight.
  • We do not sell or share data with third parties and we do not process payment data.
  • If you sign in, the app asks our servers which plan you have (free trial or Patreon subscription). From Patreon we only receive the membership data described below, never card or payment details.

3. What data we process and why

Visiting the website

When you visit the website, the server and the hosting provider record IP address, date and time, requested page and browser type in their technical logs. The IP address is also used, in memory only, to limit the number of download requests. Purpose: running and securing the website. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Signing in with Discord

If you sign in with Discord from the app we receive and store your Discord account ID, display name and avatar, plus the date you registered and last signed in. The session is stored only as a cryptographic hash of the token and expires after 90 days of inactivity. We never receive your email or password. Purpose: providing your account and the online features. Legal basis: performance of the service you request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

Uploaded combat logs

When you upload a fight we store the fight data (boss, duration, damage, healing, classes, region, app version and the names of the in-game characters in the fight), the visibility you choose and the view count. On public and unlisted logs your Discord name and avatar are shown as the uploader. Public logs feed per-class statistics in aggregate form, without names. Legal basis: performance of the service (Art. 6(1)(b)) and, for other players' character names, the legitimate interest in showing the complete fight (Art. 6(1)(f)). If you appear in a log uploaded by someone else you can ask us to remove your name.

Free trial

The first time the app checks your plan we record the start date of your 14-day trial, linked to your account. To decide whether you are eligible we use the creation date of your Discord account, derived from the Discord ID we already hold: we ask Discord for nothing more. Purpose: providing the trial and allowing only one trial per account. Legal basis: performance of the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and legitimate interest in preventing abuse (Art. 6(1)(f)).

Subscriptions with Patreon

When you link Patreon you authorise PowerMeter, on Patreon's page, to read your identity and your memberships. We store your Patreon user ID, the ID of your membership in the PowerMeter campaign, the plan (derived from the tier price), the membership status (for example active, payment declined, former member), the date of the last charge, the date on which we first recorded a paid membership (used for the Founder badge) and the date of linking. We do not request your name, email or address from Patreon and we never receive card or payment details; the access token Patreon gives us when you link is used once and not stored.

Patreon notifies our server (webhook) when a membership in the PowerMeter campaign is created, changed or deleted: each notification is verified through its signature, and we then read the membership again from Patreon's API. We also refresh it periodically. For this reason we may hold the membership data above for a Patreon member who has not linked a PowerMeter account; that data is not tied to any account until it is linked.

From this data the server calculates your plan and sends the app a digitally signed permit, stored on your computer, containing your account ID, the plan, the Founder badge, any custom features and the issue and expiry dates. If we grant you a plan by hand we store the plan, its expiry and an internal note; for Empyrean custom features we store which ones are enabled for your account. Purpose: providing the subscription and its features. Legal basis: performance of the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); for the checks against sharing and abuse (one Patreon account per PowerMeter account), legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)).

Contact

If you email us we process the message only to reply to you.

4. Who we share data with

  • Netsons: hosting provider for the servers and database, processing data on our behalf.
  • Discord: sign-in happens on Discord's pages, which process your data under Discord's own privacy policy.
  • GitHub: the download button redirects you to the app file on GitHub, which receives your IP address under its own privacy policy.
  • Patreon: handles payments, billing, renewals and refunds as an independent data controller, under its own privacy policy. With Patreon we only exchange what is needed to check memberships, as described in section 3.

5. How long

  • Account: until you ask us to delete it.
  • Uploaded logs: until you delete them from the app or ask us to delete your account.
  • Sessions: deleted after 90 days of inactivity or on sign-out. Temporary sign-in codes: a few minutes.
  • Server technical logs: for the limited time needed for security and troubleshooting.
  • Trial start date: as long as your account exists, so that the trial cannot be repeated.
  • Patreon link: until you unlink Patreon or delete your account. Membership data received from Patreon: until you ask us to delete it.
  • Plans granted by us: for their duration or until revoked. The permit on your computer expires after at most 7 days and is replaced at every check.

6. Your rights

You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, restrict its processing, receive it in a portable format and object to processing based on legitimate interest. You can delete your logs at any time from the app; to delete your account or exercise the other rights write to info@letrionlabs.it. You can also lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (garanteprivacy.it) or with the authority of the country where you live.

7. Children

The Service is not intended for anyone under 14. Signing in requires a Discord account, subject to Discord's age limits.

8. Security

All traffic uses HTTPS only, session tokens are stored as hashes and database access is restricted to the server. Patreon notifications are accepted only with a valid signature, and plan permits are digitally signed by the server. No system is one hundred percent secure: if you find a problem, please tell us.

9. Cookies

The website uses no cookies. Details are in the cookie policy.

10. Changes

We may update this policy. The last-updated date is shown at the top; significant changes will be announced on the website or in the app's release notes.
